prompt.en: Keep the 920px single reading column, the three-part folio header with hairline bottom rule, the kicker row (uppercase tag chip plus mono location meta), the oversized display headline with one italic ink-blue word, the lede paragraph, the three-column pillar grid with numbered mono kickers and top rule, the left-ruled pull quote with mono attribution, and the three-part colophon footer. Replace the studio name, issue and volume numbers, license, city and coordinates, headline, lede, pillar titles and body, quote and attribution, and footer links with the user's real content; the example's KAMI · OpenDesign Studio and Issue №26 must leave no trace. Keep only the parchment, ink and ink-blue hex values, one serif family plus mono for meta labels, and no shadows, gradients or rounded corners. Before finishing, check that the headline still breaks into two lines without overflow, that the three pillars stack cleanly at narrow widths, that long pillar text does not unbalance the row, and that any image the user supplies is a paper-tint block with a 1px ink outline.
prompt.zh: 保留示例的 920px 单一阅读栏、带细线底边的三段式刊头、眉标行（大写标签块 + 等宽地点信息）、含一个墨蓝斜体词的大号展示标题、导语段、带编号等宽眉标和顶线的三栏要点、左侧墨蓝竖线的引语及等宽署名、以及三段式版权脚注。把工作室名、期号卷号、许可证、城市与坐标、标题、导语、三栏标题与正文、引语与署名、脚注链接都换成用户的真实内容；示例里的 KAMI · OpenDesign Studio 和 Issue №26 不能留下任何痕迹。只保留羊皮纸、墨色和墨蓝三个色值，一种衬线字体加等宽字体做小标签，不要阴影、渐变和圆角。完成前检查：标题仍能自然断成两行且不溢出，三栏在窄屏下整齐堆叠，较长的要点文字不会撑歪整行，用户提供的图片用纸色块加 1px 墨色描边表示。

description.en: Warm parchment canvas (#f5f4ed), monochrome ink-blue accent (#1B365D), one serif family, and editorial-grade typography.
description.zh: 暖羊皮纸底、墨蓝单色强调的编辑级单页文档，含页眉刊头、大标题、导语、三栏要点、引语和版权脚注。

style.en: Warm parchment one-pager with a single ink-blue accent, one serif family, mono meta labels and hairline rules; print-like, calm and motionless.
style.zh: 暖羊皮纸底的单页文档，墨蓝单色强调，单一衬线字体配等宽小标签，细线分隔，像印刷品，安静无动效。

prompt.en: Keep the centered 800px column, the header, the full-width search field with icon, the row of category pills with 'All' active, the stacked accordion cards with rotating chevrons and animated expansion, the no-results message and the footer CTA card. Populate the accordion with the user's real questions across 3–4 categories. Replace the page title, subtitle, category labels, every question and answer, and the support email/link with the user's real content; the example's generic placeholder questions and support@example.com must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that search and category filters work together and are case-insensitive, that keyboard focus and aria-expanded states are correct, that long answers are not clipped by the expansion height, and that the layout holds at narrow widths and in the empty state.
prompt.zh: 保留居中的 800px 单栏、页头、带图标的整宽搜索框、含默认选中“全部”的分类胶囊行、带旋转箭头和展开动画的堆叠手风琴卡片、无结果提示和底部联系卡片。用用户真实的 3–4 个分类问题填充手风琴。把页面标题、副标题、分类名称、所有问题和答案、支持邮箱/链接换成用户的真实内容；示例里的通用占位问题和 support@example.com 不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：搜索和分类筛选能同时生效且不区分大小写，键盘焦点和 aria-expanded 状态正确，长答案不会被展开高度裁切，窄屏和空状态下布局正常。

description.en: A Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page with collapsible accordion sections, search functionality, and category filtering.
description.zh: 带搜索、分类筛选、可折叠问答列表和联系支持入口的帮助中心页面。

style.en: Centered single-column FAQ on near-white with white accordion cards, a bright blue accent, rounded category pills and soft shadows; calm and low in motion.
style.zh: 居中的单栏常见问题页，近白底、白色手风琴卡片、亮蓝强调、圆角分类胶囊和柔和阴影，安静少动效。

prompt.en: Keep the paper-toned deck frame, the top line with section mark, the three switchable panels (metrics grid with a large lime hero and pink/peach stat cards, three pastel insight cards, and the retention split with legend and line chart), the bottom date/volume/pager bar, and the count-up and chart-reveal motion. Replace the Field Notes name, headlines, insight copy, metric labels and numbers, chart series and legend labels, dates, volume and page numbers with the user's real report content; no trace of the example's Field Notes branding may remain. Before finishing, check that the pager switches all three panels, that metrics and chart values agree, that the chart has axis labels and units, that long insight text fits its card, and that the grids stack cleanly at narrow widths.
prompt.zh: 保留纸感报告外框、带章节标记的顶行、三个可切换面板（含大号青柠主卡和粉/桃色数据卡片的指标栅格、三张粉彩洞察卡片、带图例和折线图的留存分栏）、底部日期/卷号/翻页条，以及数字递增和折线显现动效。把 Field Notes 名称、标题、洞察文案、指标标签和数字、图表系列和图例、日期、卷号和页码换成用户真实的报告内容；示例里的 Field Notes 品牌不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：翻页能切换三个面板，指标和图表数值一致，图表有坐标标签和单位，长洞察文案能放进卡片，窄屏下栅格正常堆叠。

description.en: Editorial "Field Notes" report template with soft paper background, serif hero typography, rounded pastel insight cards, and a retention chart panel.
description.zh: 奶油纸底、粉彩卡片、衬线大标题和留存折线图组成的三视图编辑风报告页。

style.en: Warm paper background with lime, pink and peach pastel cards, serif display headlines, sans-serif body, a clean retention chart and restrained motion; medium density.
style.zh: 暖纸色背景，青柠、粉、桃色粉彩卡片，衬线大标题配无衬线正文，留存折线图干净，动效克制，信息密度中等。

prompt.en: Keep the phone frame, the status bar, the centered logo block, the welcome header, the labeled form fields (country-code selector plus phone input, password field with show/hide toggle), the right-aligned forgot-password link, the full-width primary button with its loading spinner, the 'or continue with' divider, the two social SSO buttons and the sign-up footer of the example. Replace the app name Nova, the logo mark, the headline, the supporting copy, the placeholders, the country code and the social providers with the user's real content; no trace of Nova may remain. Before finishing, check that everything fits 375px without horizontal scroll, that labels sit above inputs rather than only in placeholders, that touch targets are at least 44px, and that the error and loading states still display correctly.
prompt.zh: 保留示例的手机外框、状态栏、居中的标志区、欢迎标题、带标签的表单字段（区号选择加手机号输入、带显示/隐藏切换的密码框）、右对齐的忘记密码链接、带加载转圈的整宽主按钮、“or continue with”分隔线、两个社交登录按钮和底部注册链接。把应用名 Nova、标志图形、标题、说明文案、占位文字、区号和社交平台换成用户的真实内容；不能留下任何 Nova 的痕迹。完成前检查：内容在 375px 宽度内不出现横向滚动，标签在输入框上方而不只靠占位文字，可点击区域不小于 44px，错误态和加载态仍然正常显示。

description.en: Mobile login and authentication flow screens
description.zh: 手机外框内的登录界面，含手机号与密码输入、显示密码切换、社交登录和注册链接。

style.en: One rounded phone frame on cool grey-white with an indigo accent, 12px rounded inputs, centered stack and only a spinner for motion.
style.zh: 冷灰白底上的单个圆角手机外框，靛蓝强调色，12px 圆角输入框，居中纵向排布，仅有加载转圈动效。

prompt.en: Keep the 1920×1080 dark stage, the top caption row, the tilted iPhone with notch, status bar, header, template tile, input block, CTA and tab bar, the MacBook with window chrome and its three-pane sidebar / editor / preview layout, the glass lens flares, the mirrored ground and the bottom slug footer. Replace the codename, caption text, screen content, task names, metrics, preview slide copy and footer slug with the user's real product content; the example's made-up product Atlas and its numbers must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that each screen's content fits inside its frame without clipping, that in-screen type stays at realistic mobile and desktop sizes, that no external mockup images are used, and that the composition still reads when scaled down.
prompt.zh: 保留 1920×1080 的深色舞台、顶部说明行、带刘海/状态栏/标题/模板卡/输入框/主按钮/标签栏的倾斜 iPhone、带窗口栏和三栏（侧栏/编辑器/预览）布局的 MacBook、玻璃光斑、镜面地面和底部角标。把代号、说明文字、屏幕内容、任务名、指标、预览页文案和底部角标换成用户真实的产品内容；示例里虚构的 Atlas 及其数字不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：每个屏幕的内容都在外框内没有被裁切，屏内字号保持真实的手机和桌面尺寸，没有使用外部样机图片，整体缩小后仍然可读。

description.en: Static iPhone and MacBook 3D-style showcase with real HTML embedded on screens, glass-lens refraction, and 360-degree turntable composition.
description.zh: 深色舞台上倾斜摆放 iPhone 与 MacBook 立体模型，屏幕内嵌真实界面内容的 16:9 展示图。

style.en: Dark charcoal 16:9 stage with a tilted iPhone and MacBook, metallic gradients, glass lens flares and a mirrored floor; cinematic and low in motion.
style.zh: 深色 16:9 舞台上倾斜摆放 iPhone 与 MacBook，金属渐变、玻璃光斑与镜面地面，电影感强，动效极少。

prompt.en: Keep the 1080×1920 9:16 poster container, the top label and glyph row, the centered oversized headline with its italic serif accent word, the one-line subtitle, the 3–5 item feature list with icon/title/description, and the bottom QR block with command line. Replace the product name, release label, headline, subtitle, feature copy, numbers, links, emoji/glyph and QR placeholder with the user's real campaign content; the example's made-up product HTML Anything and its v0.1 release must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that the headline and subtitle fit the poster without clipping, that the feature list stays between 3 and 5 items, that the QR area is clearly a placeholder or a real code, and that white text keeps contrast over the gradient at narrow widths.
prompt.zh: 保留 1080×1920 的 9:16 海报容器、顶部标签与图形行、居中的超大标题及斜体衬线强调词、一句话副标题、3–5 条图标加标题加描述的要点列表，以及底部二维码和命令行区块。把产品名、发布标签、标题、副标题、要点文案、数字、链接、emoji/图形和二维码占位换成用户真实的营销内容；示例里虚构的 HTML Anything 及其 v0.1 发布信息不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：标题和副标题在海报内不被裁切，要点列表保持 3–5 条，二维码区域明确是占位或真实二维码，窄屏下白色文字在渐变上仍有足够对比。

description.en: Vertical poster or Moments-style share image with strong visual impact.
description.zh: 竖版 9:16 营销海报，含渐变背景、噪点纹理、超大标题、要点列表和二维码占位。

style.en: Bold vertical 9:16 poster with a terracotta-to-indigo gradient mesh, gold serif accent, huge black-weight headline, grain texture and high contrast; static.
style.zh: 大胆的 9:16 竖版海报，陶土色到靛蓝的渐变网格、金色衬线强调、超大黑体标题和噪点纹理，高对比、静态。

prompt.en: Keep the sticky top navigation with its anchor links, the centered hero with version, date and one-sentence summary, the section order (Added, Fixed, Breaking changes, Known issues, Upgrade note), the three-column log-row grid, the thin section dividers and the footer of the example. Replace the version number, date, summary, every log entry, section metadata and navigation labels with the user's real release details; the example's v2.3.1 and placeholder dashes must not remain. When details are missing, write the explicit 'None' or 'No ... provided' statements instead of inventing them. Before finishing, check that every topnav anchor has a matching section id, that long entry titles wrap cleanly in the log rows, that the layout collapses correctly at narrow widths, and that no placeholder links remain.
prompt.zh: 保留示例的吸顶导航及其锚点链接、居中的版本/日期/一句话摘要主视觉、版块顺序（新增、修复、破坏性变更、已知问题、升级说明）、三栏日志行栅格、细分隔线和页脚。把版本号、日期、摘要、每条日志、版块元信息和导航标签换成用户真实的发布内容；示例里的 v2.3.1 和占位破折号不能留下。缺少细节时写明“None”或“No ... provided”式的明确说明，不要编造。完成前检查：每个导航锚点都有对应的版块 id，长条目标题在日志行中正常换行，窄屏下布局正确折叠，没有残留占位链接。

description.en: Release notes one-page HTML with highlights, Added, Fixed, Breaking changes, Known issues, and Upgrade note. Writes explicit "None" style sections whenever the user does not provide details.
description.zh: 包含版本摘要、新增、修复、破坏性变更、已知问题和升级说明的单页发布说明。

style.en: Warm off-white release notes page with serif display headings, monospace meta labels, a terracotta accent, thin rules and calm spacing.
style.zh: 暖白底发布说明页，衬线大标题、等宽小标签、陶土色强调，细分隔线，排版安静克制。

prompt.en: Keep the top metadata bar, the two-column hero (decision question, confidence and segment pills, three-stat readout, dark recommendation panel with risk list), the filterable four-column evidence ledger, the three-card theme map with evidence-id chips, the opportunity matrix table, the two-column decision memo and contradictions block, the numbered experiment queue with definition lists, and the assumptions and limitations section. Replace the decision question, research material, quotes, metrics, evidence IDs, theme names, scores, memo points, experiment owners and thresholds with the user's real research; the example's onboarding-checklist decision and all its numbers must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that every evidence ID cited in themes and the memo exists in the ledger, that source filters show the right cards and All restores them, that long quotes and table rows do not break the layout at narrow widths, and that no quote, sample size or metric is invented.
prompt.zh: 保留顶部元信息栏、双栏主视觉（决策问题、置信度与人群标签、三项统计、深色建议面板与风险列表）、可筛选的四列证据台账、带证据编号标签的三卡片主题地图、机会矩阵表格、双栏决策备忘与矛盾说明、带编号和定义列表的实验队列，以及假设与局限版块。把决策问题、研究材料、引语、指标、证据编号、主题名、评分、备忘要点、实验负责人和阈值换成用户真实的研究内容；示例里的新手引导清单决策及其所有数字不能留下痕迹。完成前检查：主题和备忘中引用的每个证据编号都存在于台账中，来源筛选显示正确的卡片且“全部”能恢复，长引语和表格行在窄屏下不破坏布局，没有编造引语、样本量或指标。

description.en: Turn messy user research notes, interviews, support tickets, surveys, and product context into an evidence-backed decision room: a single HTML artifact with an evidence ledger, theme map, confidence heatmap, opportunity matrix, decision memo, and experiment queue.
description.zh: 把访谈、工单和指标整理成证据台账、主题地图、机会矩阵、决策备忘和实验队列的研究决策页。

style.en: Warm paper-toned research dashboard with serif display type, grid-paper background, deep green and rust accents, dense evidence cards and tables.
style.zh: 暖纸质研究看板，衬线大标题、网格纸背景、深绿与铁锈色强调，证据卡片和表格信息密集。

prompt.en: Keep the A4 page container (210mm wide, min 297mm tall, 16–18mm padding, soft shadow on a warm grey backdrop), the oversized name header with the role line and the pipe-separated contact row, the 8/4 two-column grid, the section headings with a short accent bar and uppercase letter-spaced labels, the role rows with right-aligned date ranges, the square-marker bullet lists, the skill chips, and the @media print rules. Replace the name, role, contact details, summary, companies, job titles, dates, achievement bullets and numbers, project names and star counts, school, GPA, skills, languages and interests with the user's real content; the example's made-up person 林清禾 and company Acme AI must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that everything still fits on one A4 page without spilling over, that long bullets wrap cleanly and dates stay right-aligned, and that printing hides the page shadow and background while keeping the accent color.
prompt.zh: 保留 A4 页面容器（宽 210mm、高至少 297mm、内边距 16–18mm、暖灰背景上的柔和投影）、超大姓名抬头与职位行、竖线分隔的联系方式行、8/4 两栏栅格、带短强调线和大写字距的章节标题、右对齐时间区间的职位行、方形标记的项目符号列表、技能标签以及 @media print 规则。把姓名、职位、联系方式、简介、公司、职位名、时间、成就条目和数字、项目名和星数、学校、GPA、技能、语言和兴趣换成用户的真实内容；示例里虚构的林清禾和 Acme AI 不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：所有内容仍能装进一页 A4 不溢出，长条目能正常换行且时间保持右对齐，打印时隐藏页面投影和背景但保留强调色。

description.en: Modern minimal resume, single A4 page, ready for print or PDF export.
description.zh: A4 单页两栏简历，含大号姓名抬头、联系方式、个人简介、工作经历、公开项目、教育、技能标签、语言和兴趣。

style.en: Single A4 page in black, grey and white with a deep-blue accent, thin rules, a compact 8/4 two-column grid and print-ready styling; almost no motion.
style.zh: A4 单页黑白灰简历，深蓝强调色、细线分隔、8/4 两栏紧凑排版，适合打印，几乎无动效。

prompt.en: Keep the single dark card centered on its near-black radial-gradient backdrop, the fixed 720px card width, the left vote rail (up arrow, vote count, down arrow), the meta row (round subreddit badge, r/name, posted-by and time, flair chip on the right), the title, the body paragraphs and the bottom action row with comments, awards, share and the more icon. Replace the subreddit, username, timestamp, flair, title, body text, vote count, comment count and award count with the user's real content; the example's r/programming post and its author must leave no trace. If the user supplies an image, use a CSS gradient placeholder with a description instead of an external link. Before finishing, check that the vote count uses the 12.3k abbreviation style, that a long title wraps without pushing the action row out of the card, and that the body stays short enough to read as one card.
prompt.zh: 保留示例中居中于近黑径向渐变背景上的单张深色卡片、720px 固定卡宽、左侧投票栏（上箭头、票数、下箭头）、信息行（圆形子版块徽标、r/名称、作者与时间、右侧标签）、标题、正文段落，以及底部含评论、奖项、分享和更多图标的操作行。把子版块、用户名、时间、标签、标题、正文、票数、评论数和奖项数换成用户的真实内容；示例里 r/programming 的帖子和作者不能留下任何痕迹。用户提供图片时，用带描述的 CSS 渐变占位代替外链图片。完成前检查：票数使用 12.3k 这类缩写格式，长标题换行后不会把操作行挤出卡片，正文长度仍能作为一张卡片读完。

description.en: Realistic Reddit post card with vote rail and comment count, suited to video overlays or story sharing.
description.zh: 深色模式下的拟真 Reddit 帖子卡，含左侧投票栏、子版块信息、标题正文和评论操作行。

style.en: Dark Reddit card on a near-black radial gradient: orange vote rail, IBM Plex Sans, compact spacing and almost no motion.
style.zh: 近黑径向渐变背景上的深色 Reddit 卡片，橙色投票栏、IBM Plex Sans 字体，间距紧凑，几乎无动效。

prompt.en: Keep the single rounded card, its two-column split (square album cover on the left, text and controls on the right), the NOW PLAYING eyebrow with the green accent and animated wave bars, the title/artist stack, the thin progress bar with a knob and two timestamps, and the control row with shuffle, previous, white circular play button, next and repeat. Replace the album name, cover monogram text, track title, artist names, timestamps and progress percentage with the user's real content; the example's Chillhop / Lo-Fi Essentials / Sunday Afternoon / j'san content must leave no trace. Keep the cover as a CSS gradient with text, never an external image. Before finishing, check that the progress fill width matches the shown timestamps, that long titles and artist names truncate or wrap without pushing the controls out of the card, and that the wave animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
prompt.zh: 保留单张圆角卡片、左右两栏结构（左侧方形专辑封面，右侧文字与控制）、带绿色强调和音波动效的 NOW PLAYING 小标、歌名与艺人层级、带圆点和两端时间戳的细进度条，以及包含随机、上一首、白色圆形播放按钮、下一首和循环的控制行。把专辑名、封面文字、歌名、艺人名、时间戳和进度百分比换成用户的真实内容；示例里的 Chillhop / Lo-Fi Essentials / Sunday Afternoon / j'san 不能留下任何痕迹。封面始终用 CSS 渐变加文字，不使用外链图片。完成前检查：进度条填充宽度与显示的时间戳一致，长歌名和艺人名截断或换行后不会把控制行挤出卡片，音波动效在 prefers-reduced-motion 下停止。

description.en: Spotify Now Playing-style card with album art, progress bar, and playback controls, suited to video overlays or personal homepages.
description.zh: 深色渐变卡片，左侧是 CSS 渐变专辑封面，右侧是 NOW PLAYING 标签、歌名、艺人、进度条和播放控制行。

style.en: Dark Spotify-style card with a deep blue gradient, green accent, gradient album art, white type and a small looping wave animation.
style.zh: 深蓝渐变的 Spotify 风格暗色卡片，绿色强调、渐变专辑封面、白色字体，带轻微循环音波动效。

prompt.en: Keep the single centered card on the dark radial background, the rounded black card with a 1px border, the header row (avatar, display name, verified badge, @handle, timestamp, overflow menu), the post body with X-blue links, the optional quote card and 16:9 image placeholder, and the engagement row with reply, repost, like and view icons plus K/M-formatted numbers. Replace the display name, handle, avatar gradient, post text, timestamp, metrics and any quoted or image content with the user's real content; the example's AlchainHust identity and its Markdown/HTML post must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that the post reads as one coherent statement within 280 characters, that numbers are formatted as 1.2K/4.5M, that the card fits a 1280×720 or 1080×1080 canvas without clipping, and that no external image URLs are used.
prompt.zh: 保留深色径向背景上居中的单张卡片、带 1px 边框的黑色圆角卡片、顶部信息行（头像、显示名、蓝勾、@handle、时间、更多菜单）、带 X 蓝链接的正文、可选的引用卡和 16:9 图片占位，以及包含回复、转推、点赞和浏览量图标的互动行与 K/M 格式数字。把显示名、handle、头像渐变、正文、时间、互动数据和引用/图片内容换成用户的真实内容；示例里的 AlchainHust 身份和 Markdown/HTML 推文不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：推文是一句连贯表达且不超过 280 字符，数字按 1.2K/4.5M 格式，卡片在 1280×720 或 1080×1080 画布内不被裁切，且没有使用外部图片链接。

description.en: Realistic X post card with engagement metrics (likes, reposts, views), suited to video overlays or shareable image cards.
description.zh: 一条带蓝勾、互动数据和浏览量的拟真 X 帖子卡片，适合视频叠加或分享图卡。

style.en: Dark X-style post card centered on a near-black radial background, with a black rounded card, grey secondary text, X-blue links and compact engagement icons.
style.zh: 深色 X 风格帖子卡，近黑径向背景、黑色圆角卡片、灰色次要文字、X 蓝链接和紧凑互动图标。

prompt.en: Keep the bordered outer frame with its hard offset shadow, the small uppercase kicker line, the oversized uppercase hero title with one accent-colored word, the 2×2 four-step process card grid (big number, uppercase title, short paragraph, each card a different flat color with black border and offset shadow), the stacked layer diagram of progressively wider offset bars, and the footer with the counter. Replace the kicker, title, step names, step descriptions, layer labels and counter with the user's real content; the example's 'Creative Mode' wording and its Discover/Define/Develop/Deliver steps must leave no trace. Before finishing, check that the card grid collapses to one column below 860px, that long step titles and paragraphs still fit inside the fixed-height cards, and that the offset layer bars still read as a stack at narrow widths.
prompt.zh: 保留示例的外层粗边框和硬阴影、小号大写引导行、带一个强调色单词的超大号大写标题、2×2 四步流程卡片栅格（大号数字、大写标题、短段落，每张卡片一种纯色配黑边和硬阴影）、逐级加宽错位的层叠结构图，以及带计数器的页脚。把引导行、标题、步骤名、步骤说明、层级标签和计数器换成用户的真实内容；示例里的“Creative Mode”字样和 Discover/Define/Develop/Deliver 四个步骤不能留下任何痕迹。完成前检查：卡片栅格在 860px 以下收成单列，较长的步骤标题和段落仍能放进固定高度的卡片，错位层级条在窄屏下仍然读得出层叠关系。

description.en: Swiss-inspired creative-mode presentation template skill with bold editorial typography, high-contrast geometric cards, interactive slide navigation, theme switching, hotspot overlays, and palette choreography in a single-file HTML artifact.
description.zh: 粗黑边框和硬阴影的瑞士风单页，包含超大标题、四步流程卡片和层叠结构图。

style.en: Brutalist Swiss editorial page on warm paper with black 3px borders, hard offset shadows, oversized uppercase type and flat pink, yellow, orange and green blocks; static.
style.zh: 暖纸色底、黑色粗边框与硬阴影的瑞士粗野风页面，超大号大写标题，粉黄橙绿四色卡片，静态无动效。
